principles: Prefer validator-compliant annotation values over changing validator rules
drivers: convergence_check currently fails only because cli-validate reports 10 task annotation errors
The affected files already have task headers, just incomplete or invalid metadata
A narrow patch is safer than weakening annotation validation

options.name: Relax the validator
cons: Would hide real future annotation mistakes

rationale: The errors are concrete metadata defects in a small set of files, so patching those headers is the narrowest fix and preserves validator value.

preMortem.mitigation: Run cli-validate after the patch and inspect exact remaining rows

preMortem.scenario: The patch accidentally changes runtime behavior
preMortem.mitigation: Limit edits to @task comment blocks only and verify git diff
